kpis.name: Monthly Lead Conversion Rate DXB
kpis.description: Percentage of new Dubai leads converted to active customers per month.

kpis.name: Quarterly Sales Revenue Target (AED)
kpis.description: Total closed deal value in AED generated per sales rep per quarter.

kpis.name: Weekly Prospect Contact Rate
kpis.description: Number of call logs and meetings logged weekly per team member.

kpis.name: Average Deal Close Duration
kpis.description: Average number of days to take a lead from New to Closed-Won.

kpis.name: Customer Response Time (Hours)
kpis.description: Average response time in hours to new inbound inquiries.

kpis.name: GITEX Campaign ROI
kpis.description: Revenue generated vs exhibition cost for GITEX leads.

kpis.name: DIFC Enterprise Acquisition
kpis.description: Number of financial institution deals signed in DIFC.

kpis.name: Proposal Win Rate
kpis.description: Ratio of proposals sent vs contract signed.

kpis.name: Cross-Sell Ratio (Addon Modules)
kpis.description: Percentage of leads buying 2+ software modules.

kpis.name: Customer Retention Rate
kpis.description: Annual contract renewal rate for Dubai clients.
